title: Tandem association of CLOCK:BMAL1 complexes on DNA enables recruitment of CBP/p300 through multivalent interactions
authors: Sharma D; Stoos L; Torgrimson MR; Crosby P; Franks KM; Parsley NC; Membreno M; Kempf G; Kater L; Gustafson CL; Lee H; Rubin SM; Michael AK; Thomä NH; Partch CL
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CLOCK:BMAL1转录因子与DNA上串联E-box及核小体的结合机制，并揭示其通过多价互作招募共激活因子CBP/p300，虽聚焦TF-DNA互作但以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，故评分为6。
abstract: The basic helix-loop-helix PER-ARNT-SIM (bHLH-PAS) transcription factor CLOCK:BMAL1 interacts with E-box motifs in the context of nucleosomes to elicit a circadian pattern of gene expression that oscillates with approximately 24 hour periodicity. Core clock genes and other highly rhythmic targets of CLOCK:BMAL1 typically possess a tandem arrangement of E-boxes that is required for robust oscillations. Here, we show that the presence of tandem E-boxes enables CLOCK:BMAL1 to bind more internal sites on the nucleosome, leading to release of DNA from the histone core and the presentation of multiple coactivator binding motifs in close proximity to facilitate multivalent interactions with the coactivator CBP/p300. We show that the transactivation domain (TAD) of BMAL1, essential for CLOCK:BMAL1 activity, interacts with several modular domains of CBP. Deletion of these CBP domains or chemical inhibition of protein-protein interactions with CBP significantly reduces or eliminates CLOCK:BMAL1-driven activity. Altogether, this suggests that multivalent interactions with CBP may play a role in the ability of tandem CLOCK:BMAL1 heterodimers to recruit this limiting cofactor in cells.
abstract_zh: 基础螺旋-环-螺旋PER-ARNT-SIM（bHLH-PAS）转录因子CLOCK:BMAL1在核小体背景下与E-box基序相互作用，引发以约24小时周期振荡的昼夜节律基因表达模式。核心时钟基因及其他高度节律性的CLOCK:BMAL1靶标通常具有串联排列的E-box，这对于稳健的振荡是必需的。在此，我们表明串联E-box的存在使CLOCK:BMAL1能够结合核小体上更多的内部位点，导致DNA从组蛋白核心释放，并在近距离内呈现多个共激活因子结合基序，以促进与共激活因子CBP/p300的多价相互作用。我们显示，BMAL1的反式激活结构域（TAD）对CLOCK:BMAL1活性至关重要，它与CBP的多个模块化结构域相互作用。删除这些CBP结构域或化学抑制与CBP的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，会显著降低或消除CLOCK:BMAL1驱动的活性。总体而言，这表明与CBP的多价相互作用可能在串联CLOCK:BMAL1异二聚体招募细胞中这一限制性辅因子的能力中发挥作用。
